cards.title: False Echo
cards.effectSummary: After a successful run on a fort, force the Corp to rez as much ice as possible from outermost inward.

cards.title: Flak
cards.effectSummary: Icebreaker: break AP subroutine for 0; pump +1 strength for 1.

cards.title: Hammer

cards.title: Japanese Water Torture
cards.effectSummary: Icebreaker: break wall subroutine for 0; variable pump +X strength with next-X-actions debt.

cards.title: Netspace Inverter

cards.title: Newsgroup Filter

cards.title: Poltergeist

cards.title: Rabbit

cards.title: Reflector
cards.effectSummary: Icebreaker: break stun, hellbolt, or knockout subroutine for 0.

cards.title: Scatter Shot
cards.effectSummary: Install with 1 recurring restricted credit for trashing upgrades; refresh at next Runner turn start if used.

cards.title: Shield
cards.effectSummary: Prevent up to 2 net damage each turn.

cards.title: Speed Trap
cards.effectSummary: After the Corp rezzes an upgrade or node and before it takes effect, pay 0 to jack out.

cards.title: Startup Immolator
cards.effectSummary: Tap and pay rez cost to trash ice after breaking all subroutines of that ice.

cards.title: Zetatech Software Installer

cards.title: Anonymous Tip

cards.title: Forged Activation Orders

cards.title: If You Want It Done Right...
cards.effectSummary: Look at top five stack cards, take one into grip, arrange the rest.

cards.title: misc.for-sale

cards.title: Open-Ended Mileage Program

cards.title: Organ Donor
cards.effectSummary: Trash up to five grip cards; gain 1 credit per trashed card.

cards.title: Security Code WORM Chip
cards.effectSummary: If the Runner made a successful HQ run this turn, trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

cards.title: Synchronized Attack on HQ
cards.effectSummary: If successful HQ run this turn, Corp discards all HQ cards unless paying 2 per retained card.

cards.title: Valu-Pak Software Bundle
cards.effectSummary: Gain up to five consecutive program-install-only actions and a temporary 1 credit for those actions.

cards.title: Arasaka Portable Prototype
cards.effectSummary: Deck: +3 MU, costs 1 agenda point to install, recurring icebreaker-use credits, one deck in play.

cards.title: Artemis 2020

cards.title: Bodyweight Data Creche

cards.title: Corolla Speed Chip

cards.title: Microtech Backup Drive
cards.effectSummary: Replacement: when installed programs would be trashed together, may stack any/all on Backup Drive; action returns top hosted card to grip.

cards.title: Pandora's Deck
cards.effectSummary: Deck: +2 MU, recurring link-increase credits, one deck in play.

cards.title: Parraline 5750
cards.effectSummary: Deck: +1 MU, recurring icebreaker-use credit, one deck in play.

cards.title: PK-6089a

cards.title: ZZ22 Speed Chip

cards.title: Corporate Retreat
cards.effectSummary: Scored agenda action gains 6, but ability is lost as soon as Corp rezzes or installs any card.

cards.title: Corporate War
cards.effectSummary: On Corp score: if Corp has at least 12 credits, gain 12; otherwise lose all credits.

cards.title: Data Fort Reclamation

cards.title: Marine Arcology
cards.effectSummary: Scored agenda action with tap/use component gains 1 credit.

cards.title: Political Overthrow

cards.title: Security Purge
cards.effectSummary: On score, reveal top three R&D cards; install and rez any ice for free; trash the rest.

cards.title: Haunting Inquisition
cards.effectSummary: Code gate with run/action lock for Runner's next six actions and End the run.

cards.title: Tutor

cards.title: Viral 15
cards.effectSummary: Run-wide jack-out tax and run-wide program trash after passing each rezzed ice unless Runner jacks out.

cards.title: Virizz
cards.effectSummary: For remainder of run, Runner pays 1 additional credit to break each ice subroutine.

cards.title: Zombie
cards.effectSummary: Sentry black ice with two brain/core damage subroutines and End the run.

cards.title: Edgerunner, Inc., Temps
cards.effectSummary: Corp gains up to three consecutive install-only actions; taking all three is optional.

cards.title: Off-Site Backups
cards.effectSummary: Bring any card from Archives into HQ.

cards.title: Planning Consultants
cards.effectSummary: Look at top five R&D cards and arrange them in any order.
